title: IIT Kanpur: overview, contacts and student portals
content:
# IIT Kanpur: overview, contacts and student portals

IIT Kanpur (IITK) was established in 1959 by the Government of India and is one of the first-generation IITs. The homepage states 9500+ students (1:1 UG:PG ratio), 570 faculty in 20 departments, 150+ postdocs, and a 1055-acre campus where nearly all students and faculty live.

**Address:** Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, Kalyanpur, Kanpur 208016, Uttar Pradesh.

## Phone numbers
- Institute: 0512-259-0151 (the homepage link points to 0512-259-4999; check https://www.iitk.ac.in/contact)
- Security: 0512-259-7999, 7994
- Police: 0512-259-7309
- Health Center: 0512-259-7777
- Fire Station: 0512-221-8999

There is no general enquiry email; the contact page uses a form: https://www.iitk.ac.in/contact

## Student portals
- Pingala (registration, add/drop): https://pingala.iitk.ac.in/IITK-0/login
- Dean of Academic Affairs (DOAA) and academic calendar: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/academic-calendar
- P K Kelkar Library: https://pkklib.iitk.ac.in/
- Student Placement Office (SPO): https://spo.iitk.ac.in/
- Health Services: https://www.iitk.ac.in/hc/
- Center for Mental Health and Wellbeing (CMHW): https://iitk.ac.in/cmhw/
- Webmail: https://webmail.iitk.ac.in
- Students page: https://www.iitk.ac.in/students

title: IIT Kanpur admissions: routes by programme
content:
# IIT Kanpur admissions: routes by programme

## B.Tech, B.Tech–M.Tech dual degree, integrated M.Sc
Admission once a year in July through the all-India Joint Entrance Examination held in April/May (JEE Advanced: https://www.jeeadv.ac.in/; IIT seats are allotted through JoSAA). Minimum qualification: pass in 10+2 or equivalent. The admissions page states the candidate should not be more than 25 years of age (30 for SC/ST) as on 1 October after admission; check current JEE (Advanced) eligibility, which governs. Seats are offered by choice against All India Rank.

## M.Sc (2-year) and M.Sc–PhD dual degree
Through the Joint Admission Test to M.Sc (**JAM**). GATE/JAM: https://iitk.ac.in/gate/

## M.Tech
Normally twice a year (July and December); advertisements in March/April and September. Needs a B.Tech/B.E. or M.Sc in the relevant area and a valid **GATE** score. Sponsored candidates from industry or research organisations need not have GATE.

## PhD
Generally July and December, advertised by March/April and September. Basic qualification: a Master's in Engineering, Science, or Humanities and Social Sciences (or allied area); Bachelor's in Engineering may be considered. GATE/UGC/CSIR qualification is required for Science and HSS. Selection by interview.

## Other programmes
MBA through **CAT** (https://iitk.ac.in/ime/); M.Des through **CEED**; DIIT only for industry-sponsored candidates.

## January 2027 session (MS by Research, PhD)
- Portal open **16 Oct 2026, 2:00 PM to 3 Nov 2026, 2:00 PM** (closed).
- Application fee: **Rs. 500** (General, EWS, OBC, OBC-NCL); **Rs. 250** (SC/ST and all DAP). Non-refundable.
- Withdrawal before **13 Dec 2026** carries a **Rs. 2,500** deduction.
- Details: https://iitk.ac.in/doaa/pgadmission/ · PG Manual: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/data/PG-Manual.pdf

title: IIT Kanpur academic calendar and counselling support (CMHW)

# IIT Kanpur academic calendar and counselling support (CMHW)

## Academic calendar
The DOAA page https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/academic-calendar lists PDFs by year (open them for semester, registration and exam dates):
- Academic Calendar 2027: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/data/Calendar-2027.pdf
- Holidays 2027: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/data/Holidays-2027.pdf
- Academic Calendar 2026: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/data/Calendar-2026.pdf
- Holidays 2026: https://www.iitk.ac.in/doaa/data/Holidays-2026.pdf

## Fees
Fee amounts weren't available on the pages read; check https://www.iitk.ac.in/students or the DOAA.

## Center for Mental Health and Wellbeing (CMHW)
- Address: House No. 503, Type V, IIT Kanpur, UP 208016
- Phone: +91-512-679-7784 · Hours: Mon–Fri, 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Email: counselor@iitk.ac.in (counsellor), ug_cmhw@iitk.ac.in (UG), pg_cmhw@iitk.ac.in (PG), headadmin_cmhw@iitk.ac.in, headclinical_cmhw@iitk.ac.in
- Book a session: https://www.iitk.ac.in/counsel/appointment_self.php (regular), https://www.iitk.ac.in/counsel/appointment_SST.php (single session, in person), https://www.iitk.ac.in/counsel/appointment_SST_Online.php (single session, online)
- **Emergency:** go to the Health Centre (0512-259-7777). External counselling, 24x7: https://iitk.ac.in/cmhw/pages/external-counselling
